label: copy-phase input f/h (rare, sparse subset)
explanation: 88% of activation mass is in the copy phase and 89% is on steps whose input token is f or h (15x and 14x lift), mostly mid-to-late recall (recall_idx 3-8, t 12-16, long sequences L=8-9). Copy-phase f/h input recovers 87% of mass but precision is only ~0.8%: the feature fires on about 1 in 100 such steps, and the conditions that pick out that subset were not found. Enriched output tokens (0, u, e) raise precision to ~7% but cut recall to ~48%. Next-output and prev-token tables showed weak enrichment and did not help. A small remainder (~11%) fires late in the original phase (t 4-7) on assorted letters (k, l, d, a). It almost never fires at t<4, at the delimiter, or for L=3. Magnitude is fairly uniform (median 0.12, max 0.22), and coverage is flat across activation quartiles.
